review.reason: The mapped layout, hazards, tees, and continuous natural-looking greens are clearly represented. The detached Hole 3 fairway patch lacks clearly visible alternating stripes at thumbnail scale, so it does not read consistently as fairway.

issues.detail: The small detached fairway patch between T3 and G3 has no clearly visible edge-to-edge alternating mowing stripes.
issues.consequence: In the overview, the patch may read as uniform turf or an additional green-like area rather than a fairway section.
